activity.notes: Basil Brooke, created Viscount Brookeborough in 1952, served as Prime Minister of Northern Ireland from 1 May 1943 to 26 March 1963. ATLAS treats Northern Ireland as the devolved political community he governed, rather than presenting him as prime minister of the United Kingdom.

sources.title: Statsministrar i Nord-Irland 1921–1972 — Store norske leksikon
sources.citation_text: Store norske leksikon lists Basil Stanlake Brooke (Lord Brookeborough) as Prime Minister of Northern Ireland from 1 May 1943 to 26 March 1963.
